note: Normative-clause -> covering-test traceability (the SEP-2484 pattern). Clauses are drawn from SEP-0000 (section is the SEP-0000 section number) and from the corpus SEPs the implementation adopts (section is the corpus SEP number, e.g. 2053). Each clause names the tests in each arm that exercise it; conformance/test_traceability.py and rust/tests/traceability.rs verify that every named test exists, so a renamed or removed test breaks the matrix. This doubles as yamp's own conformance evidence. Regenerate coverage by hand when clauses or tests change.

clauses.text: The intermediary MUST support server/discover, composing results from all healthy backends.
A request whose declared protocol version cannot be served MUST be rejected with error -32004, whose data names the supported set.
Compose a single initialize response whose protocolVersion and serverInfo are the intermediary's.
Compose server capabilities per the primitive table: sampling/logging any-backend, elicitation client, extensions unioned.
Tool names MUST be namespaced with the __ delimiter and reverse-resolved on tools/call.
A backend identifier carrying the __ delimiter MUST be rejected at configuration time.
Resource URIs MUST be namespaced by prepending the backend id as a path segment, and reverse-resolved on resources/read.
Implement at least one collision strategy and declare the active one; priority drops the lower-priority duplicate.
The manual strategy MUST reject an unresolved collision (two names mapping to one exposed name).
Support per-backend credential injection; a client credential MUST NOT reach a backend (confused deputy).
Header forwarding MUST be scoped per-backend.
Assign a client-facing id for a backend-initiated request, remember the association, and restore the backend's id on the client's reply.
A client-originated notification MUST be forwarded onward to the backends.
Invalidate cached capability lists on a backend list_changed and on a breaker opening.
Respect ttlMs and cacheScope: a fresh hit is served, collapsing repeated list fetches.
Add hop metadata to the _meta field of forwarded messages.
Propagate traceparent/tracestate; Level 1 forwards standard headers byte-identical.
On breaker open, remove the backend's tools from the list, emit tools/list_changed, and return -32003 on its calls.
In body-parsing Level 2, the transport headers (Mcp-Method/Mcp-Name) MUST agree with the body; a divergent body is rejected.
An aggregating intermediary composes availableVariants across backends, offering only variants every variant-supporting backend can serve (intersection).
The intermediary forwards the client's per-request variant to backends and rejects a variant the composed set does not offer with -32602.

Pagination cursors are variant-scoped: the aggregator mints a composite cursor bound to the active variant and each paginating backend's own cursor, and reverse-resolves a continuation to exactly those backends.
A cursor used under a different variant than the one that minted it MUST be rejected with -32602 and data naming cursorVariant/requestedVariant.
In pure-server mode (a registry with zero backends), the intermediary answers server/discover and tools/list from the local handler surface.
The server-role handshake advertises a protocolVersion drawn from the single supported set, whatever the client requested.
A resources/subscribe reverse-resolves its namespaced URI to the owning backend, and the backend's notifications/resources/updated is re-namespaced so the client sees the backend__uri it holds.
